prompt_template:
Simplify the news article using only facts stated in the article. Use this exact format:

Summary:
Write a concise summary in 2 to 4 sentences.

Aspects:
Event: One concise description of the main event.
People: Mainly relevant people, or Not stated.
Organization: Mainly relevant organizations, or Not stated.
Date & Time: Relevant dates and times, or Not stated.
Location: Relevant locations, or Not stated.
Effects: Effects of the event, or Not stated.
Countermeasures: Actions taken to address the event, or Not stated.

Use every label exactly once. Do not guess information not stated in the article.

Article:
{article}
